source_title: 河洛理數·論元氣、元氣相反與反中有救說（文明書局本）
year_context_literal: 凡元氣自人當生之年干支上取與日月時不相涉
absence_literal: 如天地元氣屬乾卦中無乾而有坤則是相反矣
rescue_literal: 元氣雖衝莫作凶。要分節氣淺深中。反處氣虛無尅制。應知財壽亦豐隆。
scope: Born-year stem/branch targets and per-phase absence-plus-opposite facts under the explicitly named lower/upper/two-nuclear body scope. Not a complete rescue or Xie judgment. The Qian absence example is extended to the eight printed target groups; this scope is an implementation interpretation, not eight separately printed absence examples.
